I used the following CSS:

a[href$="/user/omitted"] {
 color: #fff !important;
 background: #009933;
 border: 1px solid #e6e6e6;
 border-radius: 2px;
 color: #666;
 line-height: 150%;
 margin-right: 5px;
 padding: 2px 4px;
 vertical-align: middle;
}

Which makes a square around the name of the user with a white border, a green fill and turns the users name white as well. That's great. But up on the Link, Comments and Upvoats I see the following:

http://puu.sh/j08K3/c12b624c9f.png

That is not so great. Any idea how I can avoid that or use some CSS to override this behaviour?

Try with:

a[href$="/user/omitted"]:not(#upvoatsGiven) {
 color: #fff !important;
 background: #009933;
 border: 1px solid #e6e6e6;
 border-radius: 2px;
 color: #666;
 line-height: 150%;
 margin-right: 5px;
 padding: 2px 4px;
 vertical-align: middle;
}
